flags.summary: A 24-year-old eleven months after a near-fatal motorcycle collision — brain surgery, roughly six operations, unresolved tremors and memory impairment still being investigated, load-provoked pain in four sites, unable to run, jump or crouch — was sold a six-month loaded kettlebell programme with no question asked at any point about medical clearance.
evidence: I was in a pretty bad accident last June. Pretty much broke every bone in my body besides my arms.
Yes, I had brain surgery.
I'm just having lingering, like, tremors and shaking from the brain injuries that I've been trying to get figured out.
I have pain in my right ankle, pain in both knees sometimes... I get pain in my right wrist and hand sometimes, like when I'm doing the bench press... Sometimes some pain in my back
I can't run, I can't jump, I can't bend certain ways... I couldn't crouch down on the ground and tie my shoe
I can't take the risk of re-breaking my ankle and shins
let's say your first circuit is just swings, right? Just record yourself doing some swings, send it to Trevor.
they've diagnosed me with scoliosis after my back break

flags.summary: Sale was closed against a demonstrably vulnerable buyer — no income for a year, roughly $30,000 in unpaid ambulance bills, self-disclosed memory impairment from brain injury — by asking what cash he had on hand, rejecting his $500 offer and setting a $1,200 floor to be funded by liquidating cryptocurrency.
evidence: I have probably about $30,000 in ambulance bills that they're asking me to pay that I just don't have the money to pay... this whole thing has put me in a lot of debt
It would definitely be hard for me to do. It would definitely be doable. But it's going to be hard for me financially.
How much do you have available, like cash on hand? Because I can still onboard you for a smaller amount and still book everything in
I should be able to at least put down a $500 payment right now.
To book in the onboarding call, the minimum I would have to do is $1,200. Do you have $1,200?
I would just have to go in, sell some of our crypto, transfer it to the bank account, and then I would be able to make the payment

I do want to let you guys know before we do start working together. There's any ever times where I'm asking you guys the same question over, like again, I apologize for that. I have pretty bad memory now from this accident

flags.summary: Rep made explicit therapeutic promises to a post-surgical trauma patient — that his knee, ankle and back pain would stop and that his body would heal correctly — and offered his own scoliosis as proof the programme resolves spinal pain.
evidence: making sure that your knees don't hurt anymore. Your ankles don't hurt anymore. Your back doesn't hurt anymore. I mean, making sure we're doing all of those movements there to make sure that everything's flexible, right? Everything is, your body's using what it's supposed to be using and everything's healing in the correct way.
I've got scoliosis I used to have loads of back really like bad back issues I have zero issues now after started training with kettlebells like two years ago so I know we can help you
definitely help dude I used to have a lot of pain I have zero pain now
for you, it's going to help you build back the foundation, especially if we combine it with mobility

flags.summary: The purchase substitutes for clinician-supervised rehabilitation that the prospect stopped before completion solely because he could not afford it, and the price was justified on the call against the cost of those physical therapy sessions.
evidence: I probably could have still been doing rehab. The only reason I stopped doing rehab was because of financial issues. It became too expensive after being out of work for a year.
I mean, I was paying more than that to go do physical therapy. And I feel like the insurance would cover most of it. I know the sessions were 950 each
I couldn't even walk by the time I started doing therapy. I was still in a wheelchair. couldn't even stand up.
Yeah, okay. That makes sense. So you've fully recovered then. And are you training right now?

flags.summary: The recording was stopped as the payment link was being sent — the fifth such cut in this batch — and the call also lost audio repeatedly, with at least three passages of content missing.
evidence: Was there anything else you wanted to go over, or are you kind of ready to rock and roll with it? I'm kind of ready to rock and roll, ready to get working. Let's do it, dude. Let me do this for you. Let me remove the note taker. Hold on.
You there still? You just got back. You broke up for a little bit.
The last thing I heard was the salmon pokeball was the last thing I heard.
Disconnected on the stair for a second.

flags.summary: Payment terms were improvised downward at the close, from an agreed $3,000 first instalment to a $1,200 minimum to secure the booking, alongside a monthly route priced at $1,200 against an effective $1,000 per month.
evidence: if you pay monthly, it's $1,200 a month instead of $1,000 a month
you can do half and half, and it stays at $6,000. So you can put $3,000 down, and then you can do $3,000 in two months' time
